description: Intent i013 (SNAPSHOT=s04, branch chardev-ioctl-divisor) complete. One finding, medium confidence: drivers/iio/adc/ad7192.c:981-991 — in ad7192_write_raw (IIO sysfs/chardev write path, dispatched from iio_write_channel_info at drivers/iio/industrialio-core.c:1010), the sampling-frequency case checks only the RAW user value (!val at line 982) and then computes the divisor 'div = st->fclk / (val * ad7192_get_f_order(st) * 1024);' at line 987 in 32-bit int arithmetic. The scaled denominator val * f_order * 1024 can wrap modulo 2^32 to exactly 0 (e.g. val = 2^22 with f_order=1, or val = 262144 with f_order=16 from chop/sinc/oversampling settings via ad7192_get_f_order/ad7192_compute_f_order), so a nonzero user input becomes a zero divisor at the division's exact integer width — the same invariant violation as the seed's 8*speed tach divisor; the div range check at line 988 executes only after the division and cannot prevent the oops. IIO core performs no numeric validation of SAMP_FREQ before write_raw. Secondary candidates all classified safe with concrete evidence: stv0367.c:2322 (all s04 registrations set symbol_rate_min=870000 and ddb path adds an explicit symbol_rate==0 guard, so scaled divisor >=870), tda10023.c:192 (attach always sets symbol_rate_min=sysclk/128 so raw sr cannot be 0 at the division), msi001.c:216 (gcd divisor k_thresh/k_frac verified numerically nonzero at the lowest clamped RF frequency), msi2500.c:774 (f_adc clamped to [1.2M,15M]; all divisions use the constant 48000000), ds3000.c:953 (raw symbol_rate range-checked >= 1000000 before symbol_rate/1000 divisor). Bounded limitations: ad7192 reachability is build/device/permission dependent and was not executed; other IIO write_raw handlers and chardev ioctl families outside media/DVB and IIO (HID, input, misc, tty, CAN, RTC, PWM, watchdog, TCG) were not exhaustively audited.
